- [LDET.2.3.4] libc implementation (glibc / musl / BSD libc).
  Recorded as provenance, not as a determinism input: every
  correctly rounded function the engine evaluates, the
  transcendentals ([LDET.3.4.4]) and the fused multiply-add
  ([LEXP.3.2.2]) alike, is compiled into the engine rather than
  taken from the C library, so 0-ULP holds across every libc DS
  ships an artefact against ([LDET.3.4.1]). The signature still carries the
  actual libc string so an integrator running on a libc
  outside that set can scope their own replay envelope.
